'''Gaav Fennro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] mild-mannered communications expert for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], he was assigned to assist the [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] team which had [[Takeover at Whisper Base|captured]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Lasre Dardano]]'s [[Whisper Base]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. The team had been compromising their data transmissions, and Fennro was sent to keep their cover intact. His codeword was "[[Dalgo/Legends|dalgo]]." Within a [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of his scheduled arrival, he was picked up by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] customs on the planet, since the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] he was traveling in was suspected of smuggling.

{{RPG}}
The operatives staged a rescue of Fennro, and the expert was able to help uncover intelligence from the base's SIGINT array.
{{Endgame}}

{{Reb-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gaav Fennro appears in an adventure seed in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] adventure, ''[[Operation: Shadowpoint]]''. The players have the option of freeing him from captivity in order to assist in the upkeep of the base.
